title: [Day 03] Full DOM snapshot with stable node ids and masking
text:
Part 4 fix is in. A masked select no longer records which option is selected. `selected` is removed, including a `selected` attribute that was in the HTML. Option labels stay. When `maskAllInputs` is false and the select is not in a masked region, `selected: true` is still recorded. ADR 0017 supersedes only that point of ADR 0015.

Checks that passed: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build`.

Still open: part 5 (`takeFullSnapshot`). The issue definition of done is not met yet.
